claims.text: The downstream tasks analyzed include sentiment classification (IMDb) and question answering (SQuAD v1.1).
DistilBERT's performance was also evaluated on the General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark, which consists of 9 tasks for natural language understanding.
